question: What was our revenue by country last year?
sql: SELECT i.billing_country, ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) FROM invoice_line il JOIN invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoice_date) = (SELECT MAX(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)) FROM invoice) GROUP BY i.billing_country

question: What was total revenue last year?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) FROM invoice_line il JOIN invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoice_date) = (SELECT MAX(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)) FROM invoice)

question: How many active customers do we have?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM invoice WHERE invoice_date > (SELECT MAX(invoice_date) FROM invoice) - INTERVAL '12 months'

question: What is our average order value?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) / COUNT(DISTINCT il.invoice_id), 2) FROM invoice_line il

question: Which genre earned the most revenue last year?
sql: SELECT g.name FROM invoice_line il JOIN invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id JOIN track t ON t.track_id = il.track_id JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoice_date) = (SELECT MAX(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)) FROM invoice) GROUP BY g.name ORDER BY SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Who are our top 3 customers by lifetime value?
sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) FROM customer c JOIN invoice i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN invoice_line il ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY 3 DESC, c.customer_id LIMIT 3

question: How much revenue did each sales rep bring in?
sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) FROM employee e JOIN customer c ON c.support_rep_id = e.employee_id JOIN invoice i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN invoice_line il ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name

question: How many units did we sell last year?
sql: SELECT SUM(il.quantity) FROM invoice_line il JOIN invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoice_date) = (SELECT MAX(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)) FROM invoice)

question: What was revenue by year?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoice_date), ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) FROM invoice_line il JOIN invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id GROUP BY 1

question: Which region generated the most revenue overall?
sql: SELECT i.billing_country FROM invoice_line il JOIN invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id GROUP BY i.billing_country ORDER BY SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers do we have in each country?
sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM customer GROUP BY country

question: Which 3 artists have the most albums?
sql: SELECT ar.name, COUNT(*) FROM album al JOIN artist ar ON ar.artist_id = al.artist_id GROUP BY ar.artist_id, ar.name ORDER BY 2 DESC, ar.name LIMIT 3

question: What was revenue for each month of last year, by month number (1-12)?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM i.invoice_date), ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) FROM invoice_line il JOIN invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoice_date) = (SELECT MAX(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)) FROM invoice) GROUP BY 1

question: Which media type sells the most units?
sql: SELECT mt.name FROM invoice_line il JOIN track t ON t.track_id = il.track_id JOIN media_type mt ON mt.media_type_id = t.media_type_id GROUP BY mt.name ORDER BY SUM(il.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many tracks are in the catalogue for each genre?
sql: SELECT g.name, COUNT(*) FROM track t JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id GROUP BY g.name

question: What is the average order value by country?
sql: SELECT i.billing_country, ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) / COUNT(DISTINCT i.invoice_id), 2) FROM invoice_line il JOIN invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id GROUP BY i.billing_country

question: How many invoices did we issue last year?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoice WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) = (SELECT MAX(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)) FROM invoice)

question: Which sales rep has the most customers?
sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name FROM employee e JOIN customer c ON c.support_rep_id = e.employee_id GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which 3 albums have the most tracks?
sql: SELECT al.title, COUNT(*) FROM track t JOIN album al ON al.album_id = t.album_id GROUP BY al.album_id, al.title ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many customers have never been active in the last 12 months?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoice i WHERE i.customer_id = c.customer_id AND i.invoice_date > (SELECT MAX(invoice_date) FROM invoice) - INTERVAL '12 months')
